note: No per-bucket request-rate ceiling is published. The published figures are per-prefix baselines that S3 scales above gradually.

503_slow_down.note: scaling signal, not a fixed quota

403_access_denied.note: permission problem; does not consume TPS quota

403_slow_down.note: occasionally returned instead of 503; treat identically

adjacent_throttles.sse_kms: KMS per-region requests/sec quota; surfaces as S3 errors
adjacent_throttles.lambda_fanout: Lambda concurrency limits; retry storms then trip S3

retry_guidance.large_request_note: for >128MB, track throughput and proactively retry the slowest 5% of requests

escape_hatch: spread keys across many prefixes and ramp traffic up gradually; no support ticket raises a per-bucket ceiling because none is published
